review_type: read-only construct, logic, evidence-role and cross-artifact consistency review; only this report written
passed_scope_checks: Industry-level allocation already appears in the original proposal; retaining that unit is not itself a change away from the research topic.
The revised main question requires document interpretation to affect allocation choice; gamma-only optimization is explicitly auxiliary.
Main taxonomy, common date, case count, rubric, source annotation and tool interface remain visibly pending.
The config explicitly rejects unsupported FF12-to-GICS conversion and real-fund prose-to-gamma calibration.
The config and main methods distinguish raw proposals from repaired allocations and report zero AI observations.
R1/R4 is described as an onset-plus-history workflow policy; actual retrieval and model-adoption effects are not claimed.
The recent 24-window numerical summary identifies overlapping windows, revised data and auxiliary scope, and does not label numerical reference values as AI observations.
Prior v4 audit scope is explicitly restricted to the prior version in the revised main artifacts.

findings.location: paper section#intro, paragraph beginning 이에 본 연구는 넓은 문제의식을
findings.evidence: The paragraph still says the study supplies the same public market data and sets hypothetical institutions differing only in paper-derived risk-aversion coefficients.
findings.problem: This describes the previous v4 main task, contradicting the new documentary main in the abstract, section 3 and config.
findings.required_correction: Replace that paragraph with the document-grounded main question and explicitly identify gamma variation as the auxiliary numerical task; correct the generator's selection rule so regeneration cannot restore the stale paragraph.

findings.evidence: The paragraph describes combining Salcher's objective, risk coefficients and public data to compare institution responses with independent reference answers, then calls that combination the study's concrete evaluation contribution.
findings.problem: It still centers the numerical design as the main contribution and leaves the impression that independent exact weights evaluate the documentary strategic task.
findings.required_correction: Assign Salcher explicitly to the numerical auxiliary module; connect the documentary main to source interpretation, applicable constraints and allocation choices, using the newer sector-task and raw-versus-repaired precedents with their adaptation limits.

findings.location: config main.calculation and workflow; institution_packet_template.json evaluation_outputs
findings.evidence: Same deterministic facilities and separate original/repaired outputs are specified, but there is no rule limiting calculator input to information available in the current stage, and the template does not explicitly preserve calculator inputs or tool-visible constraints.
findings.problem: A feasibility checker supplied evaluator-only true constraints could reveal or enforce an institution's mandate during R4 stages 1-3, defeating the timing intervention even while raw outputs are retained.
findings.required_correction: State that model-facing calculators may use only current-stage model-visible facts or model-supplied parsed fields, never evaluator-only annotations or not-yet-revealed mandates; save tool arguments, stage-visible constraints and raw/tool results separately, and run gold checks offline.

findings.evidence: The note says v4 files remain unchanged and that recent data/cases have not been rebuilt, whereas the same file points to v4.1 and marks recent recomputation true.
findings.problem: Contradictory version and preparation status can mislead later work or the user about which design is authoritative.
findings.required_correction: Update the current-status fields to distinguish archived v4, current v4.1 and the prepared recent auxiliary data; retain earlier candidates only as explicitly dated research history.

findings.evidence: The packet identity is restricted to a named fund/share class, while the new main accepts house sector outlooks and correctly states that house research cannot be assigned to unrelated funds.
findings.problem: The schema and recommendation do not yet represent the issuer, responsible organizational unit and document role required by the new candidate source types.
findings.required_correction: Add institution/organization-unit identity, document role and applicability fields, retain fund/share-class identity only when applicable, and identify mandate versus house research views without merging them.

findings.evidence: The linked target did not exist at review time.
findings.problem: The published candidate link is broken and the text claims document candidates have been obtained.
findings.required_correction: Finish the candidate inventory before final review, or temporarily label and remove the unavailable link; recheck all local links in round 2.

findings.location: paper and plan section 4.1: 사람에게 검토받은 추출 기준표는 평가용으로 보관하고
findings.evidence: The sentence uses completed human-review wording although independent annotation is listed as pending and no human review artifact is present.
findings.problem: It can be read as an already completed independent human verification.
findings.required_correction: Use prospective wording and mark the review method, reviewer and review record as pending; do not conflate automated agent checks with completed human review.

findings.location: paper reference list and new source mentions
findings.evidence: Cai, the new Chen paper and Nosek are appended after Zhao outside the existing alphabetized reference list; the new Chen and existing Chen references both render as Chen et al. (2026).
findings.problem: The draft's APA formatting claim is not fully realized and the two author-year citations are ambiguous.
findings.required_correction: Integrate new references in author-alphabetic order and disambiguate the two different Chen author groups in text using initials or enough authors under APA conventions; do not automatically use 2026a/b unless the author groups actually match.

evidence_spot_checks.result: Supports sector/macro ETF allocation as an LLM task and narrative-to-allocation workflow; it does not validate LIBERA's institution-specific document design, which the draft correctly labels an adaptation.
Supports typed mandate constraints and separate raw versus post-critic adherence; published presets are researcher-specified conditions, not estimates of real institutions' preferences.
Supports distinguishing reference allocation agreement, exposure compliance and financial outcomes rather than treating weight similarity as strategic correctness.

review_limits: This review does not certify source-corpus completeness, runtime readiness, causal treatment effects, statistical power or a finalized documentary rubric.
Recent numerical solver outputs were read for scope and consistency; the independent math audit remains a separate review.
The candidate document file may be under concurrent construction; the round-2 review should inspect its completed version.
